title: Tic-tac at 31 times the speed of sound with no sonic signature

tellings.quote: so when an object can travel at greater than five times the speed of sound like the tic-tac which is estimated to reach at least 31 times the speed of sound and it doesn't disturb the air around you

plain: Deep Prasad, a young researcher interviewed by podcast host Jesse Michels in 2022, talks about the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. He says it is estimated to reach at least 31 times the speed of sound without disturbing the air around it, which would mean it moves in a way no known aircraft can.
